name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Income support to eligible farmer families, paid in instalments directly to bank accounts (DBT).
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families as per scheme guidelines.

name: PM Awas Yojana (PMAY - Urban / Gramin)
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Ministry of Rural Development
benefit: Housing assistance for eligible urban and rural beneficiaries.
eligibility: Based on income category and housing status as per scheme guidelines.

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (National Health Authority)
benefit: Health insurance cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation for eligible families.
eligibility: Families identified under SECC database and other notified categories.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
benefit: LPG connections for women from eligible households.
eligibility: Adult women from eligible households as per scheme guidelines.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
benefit: Basic bank accounts with RuPay debit card and accident insurance cover.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen without a bank account.

name: Jan Suraksha Schemes (PMJJBY, PMSBY, Atal Pension Yojana)
benefit: Low-cost life insurance, accident insurance and pension schemes through banks.
eligibility: As per individual scheme age and bank-account requirements.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
benefit: Single portal for applying to central and several state scholarship schemes.
eligibility: Varies by scholarship; students apply online with documents.

name: e-Shram Portal
benefit: National database of unorganised workers; registration is free.
eligibility: Unorganised workers as defined on the portal.

name: PM SVANidhi
benefit: Working capital loans for street vendors.
eligibility: Street vendors as identified under scheme guidelines.

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: Support, training and credit for traditional artisans and craftspeople.
eligibility: Artisans in notified trades; registration through the official portal / CSCs.

name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) / PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
benefit: Subsidised or free foodgrains through the Public Distribution System for eligible ration card holders.
eligibility: Eligible households with a valid ration card.

name: MGNREGA
benefit: Guaranteed wage employment for rural households.
eligibility: Adult members of rural households willing to do unskilled manual work.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: Small-savings scheme for the girl child, offered through post offices and authorised banks.
eligibility: Parents or guardians of a girl child within the notified age limit.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
benefit: Awareness and welfare initiative for the girl child.
eligibility: Not an individual cash-transfer scheme; run through district-level campaigns.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission
benefit: Sanitation and cleanliness programme including toilet construction support.
eligibility: As per mission guidelines.

name: DigiLocker
benefit: Free digital document wallet for storing and sharing government-issued documents.
eligibility: Any Indian resident with a mobile number / Aadhaar.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABHA)
benefit: Digital health account (ABHA) for storing health records with consent.
eligibility: Any Indian resident; creation is voluntary and free.

name: Aadhaar services (UIDAI)
benefit: Official Aadhaar enrolment, update and download services.
eligibility: Aadhaar holders and residents.

name: myScheme (National Scheme Discovery Portal)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics & IT / Digital India Corporation
benefit: Search portal that helps citizens discover government schemes they may be eligible for.
eligibility: Open to all citizens; it is a discovery tool, not a payment portal.

name: Skill India / PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
benefit: Short-term skill training with certification.
eligibility: Youth meeting the course criteria; training at accredited centres.

name: PM Mudra Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free loans for small businesses through banks and NBFCs.
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
benefit: Subsidy support for rooftop solar installation on residential rooftops.
eligibility: Residential households as per scheme guidelines; apply via the official national portal.
